system.description:
Beginning at 6th level, your combat prowess far surpasses everyone else who thinks they are your equal. When you would use a Martial Technique granted by the Moment of Stillness class feature, you can do so by only spending 1 Martial Die instead of 2.

Additionally, the condition inflicted no longer ends of the end of the affected creatures turn, instead requiring a successful resave at the end of each of the affected creatures turns to end its effects. This resave cannot be made at disadvantage.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
